_doc: Auto balance (tools/bot/autobalance.py, docs/BOT.md) - not in the web game: every form's own multipliers of its web stats. hp, atk, def, speDef, speed: x m (hp in tens); skill: base AP 100 (m - 1); pp: the PP to cast x m (in tens). Missing = 1. version: the step that wrote it (bot batches record it). Remove an entry to undo it; python tools/bot/autobalance.py --reset for the web stats, --restore <version> for an earlier step.
